scope.reviewed: three separated spans for average, unsigned median and median wrapper; ordered halfword updates and tested input space

findings.result: The 26-byte median leaf uses unsigned comparisons over full 32-bit inputs and returns the middle value. The 28-byte wrapper reads sample/history halfwords, invokes that original leaf, then writes old history[0] to history[2], original sample to history[0], and the median to sample[0]. The exact sequence is asserted.

The 58-byte average helper tests (flags & 0x1800)==0x1000. In the four-sample path it sums original sample plus history[0], [2], and [4], shifts right two, then moves old history[2] to history[4] and old history[0] to history[2]. The two-sample path sums sample plus history[0] and shifts right one. Both paths store original sample to history[0], then output to sample[0]. The body preserves the described high registers/frame.

All 1,154 original-instruction fixtures pass in isolated execution with byte-identical replay output. Exact source/range and artifact hashes pass; independent Capstone decoding is complete and matches candidate disassembly. Whole buffers, ordered writes, R4-R6/SP or R4/R5/SP, and R0 median outputs are checked.

limitations: Average fourth input is fixed at 12345 and only mode masks 0 and 0x1000 are tested.
The fixtures use separate buffers; aliasing, concurrent mutation, and physical field meanings are not established.
No canonical admission or C implementation.
